description: Propose a patch to an entity you do not own (for your own, use world_edit). Nothing changes until the entity's author calls world_accept; the author or you may world_reject it. note (required, max 140 chars) tells the author why. Open proposals expire after 7 days; limits: 20 open per proposer, 10 per entity. A write: needs a token. Returns "proposed <p_ id>". Optional room (default: your current room).
name: world_propose
